Native regressions also prove internal/IA preference over external, E1 metric addition, two-E1 comparison, external ECMP, one-ASBR ECMP and explicit interface cost overriding reference-bandwidth.

show ip route detail now displays the actual forward metric for external Type2 routes. Supplemental native tests receive complete HTTP responses in all six comparison states.
